reuse.why: Builds on getFillableCategories, the income/tracking skip and batchMessages by extracting them from setBulkAvg into forEachBulkCategory, and reuses getSheetValue/setBudget and the undoable mutator registration.

duplication.why: The new action shares the category loop with the average actions; setZero still keeps its own copy of the same loop, which the diff did not fold in.

placement.why: Action in server/budget/actions.ts and registration in budget/app.ts next to the other month-wide actions.

scope.why: Only the helper extraction, the new action, its handler type, registration, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: The category selection and income rule now live in one iterator used by the averages and the new action; setZero remaining separate is a small leftover.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getFillableCategories through the shared forEachBulkCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the loop was extracted, not copied.
